result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.invert_edge_selection()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Invert edge selection (select unselected, unselect selected). ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L8094-L8132){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.invert_edge_selection() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Invert edge selection](/assets/graphs/invert-edge-selection.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="Before: edges A–B, B–E, and E–F are selected in the accent color. After invert_edge_selection the selection flips: the other four edges are selected and those three are plain." width="100%"} Toggles the selection state of all edges: currently selected edges become unselected, and unselected edges become selected. Useful for getting the complement of an edge selection. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Selecting one edge of a 5-edge cycle and inverting flips the selection to the remaining four: ::: {#c85db191 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph().add_cycle_graph(5) first_edge = graph.get_edge_ids()[0] graph.select_edges_by_id([first_edge]).invert_edge_selection() graph.count_selected_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 4 ``` ::: :::
